newsitem.title: USA: County Seat Stores won't make interest payment.
newsitem.headline: County Seat Stores won't make interest payment.

text.p: County Seat Stores Inc said Tuesday it will not make the scheduled October 1 interest payment on its 12 percent senior subordinated notes due 2001 and 2002.
Failure to make the payment will constitute default for the notes after the 30-day grace period has expired, the company said.
The company is continuing its previously disclosed discussions with its banks and certain bondholders to try to restructure its financing and to evaluate other financial alternatives, it said.
County Seat is a retailer that sells jeans.
